scope: Approved R1-R9 builtin consumers and their actual direct/delegated/external runtime dependencies; optional discovered user extensions are not new required builtin providers.

evidence_policy.initial_state: All five acceptance fields remain not_run, even where source or installed files exist.
evidence_policy.source_is_not_acceptance: Source presence, hashes, descriptors, cached source and staged manifests establish inventory only; no model/account/settlement/installed-app test ran.
evidence_policy.operation_mapping: operation uses canonical gateway capability IDs; native contracts with requires_adapter are semantic targets, not a claim of wire compatibility. alternative_operations are supported choices for the same fixture, not duplicate paid executions.
evidence_policy.required_condition: Conditional native realtime row remains required inventory; its activation condition must be explicitly resolved and cannot be satisfied by buffered dictation.
evidence_policy.counts: Count rows, distinct consumer strings, logical bundled skill IDs and physical descriptors separately. Readback rows are protocol lifecycle dependencies, not new paid logical model calls.
evidence_policy.extension_contract: Third-party/user skills may declare purpose+operation+capabilities and invoke a private authenticated scoped broker; server supplies actor/payer/task/parentCall, model/rate and idempotency identity, returns bounded typed output/receipt and enforces no silent legacy-key fallback. Discovery alone grants no execution or billing authority; no automatic rewrite of arbitrary user scripts.

requirement_review.R2: Children, resume, compaction, seven actual auxiliary entrypoints, native title/summary, routing/safety are retained.
requirement_review.R3: All 13 catalog/bundled skills get inherited Agent rows; direct Python, delegated skills and external editable/runtime calls remain separate.
requirement_review.R4: OCR lifecycle, vision, ingest/query embeddings and multimodal embeddings, actual rerank search and audio/video ingestion ASR are explicit.
requirement_review.R5: Short/file/buffered/native realtime STT, TTS variants, generation/reference/mask editing and async video lifecycle are retained despite gaps.
requirement_review.R6: Every actual model call must resolve one coherent connection; explicit local/BYOK choices are retained without managed failure fallback.
requirement_review.R7: Every paid row requires identity, immutable rate, logical-call receipt and one settlement; readback shares original scope and never recharges.
requirement_review.R8: Installed descriptor/runtime drift and exact managed-file migrations must be tested; no source-only installed acceptance.
requirement_review.R9: Gateway, consumer fixture, actual account call, settlement and installed runtime remain independent not_run states.
